Message.Name: Sequence Number Reset Message
Message.Description: This message is sent to reset the Packet Sequence Number.

Field.Name: NextSeqNumber
Field.Description: The sequence number that will follow in the next packet. Always = 2.

Message.Name: Unavailable Message
Message.Description: This message will be sent over the Retransmission multicast channels to inform the clients of unavailability of a range of messages for which they have requested a retransmission.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: The beginning sequence number of the requested range of packets to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: The ending sequence number of the requested range of packets to be retransmitted.

Message.Name: Request Response Message
Message.Description: This message will be sent immediately via TCP/IP in response to the client's request for a retransmission, refresh, or Symbol Index information.

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number assigned by the client to the original request. It is returned by NYSE in this message for the client's identification purposes.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client that sent the request, left justified and null padded.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Status of the request.

Field.Name: RejectReason
Field.Description: The reason why the request was rejected.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Retransmission Request Message
Message.Description: This message is sent by clients to request a retransmission of missed packets.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: The beginning sequence number of the range of packets to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: The ending sequence number of the range of packets to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client sending this message, left justified and null padded.

Message.Name: Book Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: This message is sent by clients requesting a full book refresh.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: A sequence of characters representing the symbol, padded with NULLs.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client sending this message, left justified and null padded.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Response Message
Message.Description: Clients that remain connected to the Request server intraday must respond within 120 seconds to any heartbeat received with a single message of this type in its own packet.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client sending this message, left justified and null padded.

Message.Name: Extended Book Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: The Extended Book Refresh Request message allows the client to request a refresh by symbol index as opposed to symbol, and to request a refresh of all symbols in a channel.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client sending this message, left justified and null padded.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID (from the last Full Refresh Update) of the symbol for which information is requested. 0 = Requesting all symbols in this channel.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Unused. Any content will be ignored.

Message.Name: Symbol Index Mapping Request Message
Message.Description: This message is sent by clients requesting a refresh of Symbol Index mapping information only.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client sending this message, left justified and null padded.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID (from the last Full Refresh Update) of the symbol for which information is requested. 0 = Requesting all symbols in this channel.

Message.Name: Symbol Index Mapping Response Message
Message.Description: This message is sent by the NYSE in response to a Symbol Index Request.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The stock symbol in NYSE Symbology, right-padded with NULLs.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Ignore any content.

Field.Name: Symbol Index
Field.Description: This field identifies the numerical representation of the symbol.

Message.Name: Full Update Message
Message.Description: This message contains the complete order book for a single symbol, with all price points, an aggregated quantity at each price point and symbol mapping information.

Field.Name: UpdateSize
Field.Description: The number of bytes in this message including this field.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of this symbol used in other message types.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the matching engine, in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: SourceTime MicroSecs
Field.Description: The number of microseconds that have elapsed within the millisecond published in the SourceTime field.

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol.

Field.Name: SourceSessionID
Field.Description: Unused. Ignore any content.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The stock symbol in NYSE Symbology (the root, optionally followed by a space and a suffix), right-padded with NULLs.

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: The number of digits after the decimal place in all prices for this symbol.

Field.Name: QuoteCondition
Field.Description: The current quote condition for the symbol.

Field.Name: TradingStatus
Field.Description: The current trading status of the equity.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Ignore any content.

Field.Name: MPV
Field.Description: The minimum price variation, also known as Tick, the minimum amount by which prices can differ.

Field.Name: Full Price Point
Field.Description: Price Point repeating group.

Message.Name: Delta Update Message
Message.Description: A Delta Update message is published in response to events that occur in the book such as interest being added, executions, cancellations and interest routed to a different market.

Field.Name: DeltaSize
Field.Description: The number of bytes in this message including this field.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this symbol in the Full Update.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time the event occurred in the matching engine, in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: SourceTime MicroSecs
Field.Description: The number of microseconds that have elapsed within the millisecond published in the SourceTime field.

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol.

Field.Name: SourceSessionID
Field.Description: Unused. Ignore any content.

Field.Name: QuoteCondition
Field.Description: The current quote condition for the symbol.

Field.Name: TradingStatus
Field.Description: The current trading status of this symbol.

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: The number of digits after the decimal place in all prices for this symbol.

Field.Name: Delta Price Point
Field.Description: Price Point repeating group.

Field.Name: Price Numerator
Field.Description: The price (numerator) of this price point. Use the PriceScaleCode to determine the true dollar value of the price point.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total interest quantity at this price point.

Field.Name: NumOrders
Field.Description: The number of orders at this price point.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order, Buy vs Sell.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Ignore any content.

Field.Name: PriceNumerator
Field.Description: The price (numerator) of this price point. Use the PriceScaleCode to determine the true dollar value of the price point.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total interest quantity at this price point.

Field.Name: ChgQty
Field.Description: The volume of the event taking place (i.e size of the order, cancel or execution).

Field.Name: NumOrders
Field.Description: The number of orders at this price point.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order, Buy vs Sell.

Field.Name: ReasonCode
Field.Description: This field identifies why the volume at the price point was modified.

Field.Name: LinkID1
Field.Description: Unique ID for an execution. Correlates to the Deal ID in the gateway Execution Report msg.

Field.Name: LinkID2
Field.Description: Unused. Ignore any content.

Field.Name: LinkID3
Field.Description: Unused. Ignore any content.
